title: Nick Cave & Kylie Minogue · Where the Wild Roses Grow
description: The complete supplied video: dark river, reeds and willow branches, a red-haired singer in a white slip dress floating face-up, Nick in a white shirt kneeling beside her, soft rose-filled portraits, touching hands, a snake across the gown and a red rose at her lips. Original music with two physical mouth-engine singers.
